item.text:
You can use any Mistral model available for chat completions; each agent’s `model` is selected from the available chat-completion models. Agents may use different models from one another. [Mistral Agents & Conversations documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api)

There is no limit on the number of chained handoffs in a workflow. [Mistral Handoffs documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/handoffs)
